description: Defines the LeaveRequestComment entity class with annotations for ORM mapping, representing comments associated with leave requests in the HRM system.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: An entity class representing comments made on leave requests, including details about the comment, creator, and associated leave request.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a leave request with this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the user who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee record of the creator.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee record as the creator.
